sourceCaption:
Alex Bregman is back in the Cubs’ lineup just five days after suffering a facial fracture 😳

Bregman was hit by a foul ball while in the on-deck circle in Cincinnati, fracturing bones around his eye. He’s DHing and batting third against the Red Sox.

(via @mlb, @nesn)
